decisions.summary: Scope from the kept maps' own gen-cache entries (pool hamlets, magistracy sheets, country shrine): a recorded function or method, a class one of whose methods ran or which executed code constructs or names, a constant an executed function or an in-use knob's registration reads, a knob in use (the registry's knob resolved by name - resolve/resolve_knob/pin_knob/KNOBS[...] - or its typing rule run; not a hamlet's own hamletgen/ table rolled under the same name) and a module-level claim on one, any unit under hamletgen/, KEPT_CHECKS, buildings* as mode-a; a claim whose value no kept map reads though its unit runs deferred with its measured reason; everything else deferred (897 of 3927 units, 14 single claims)
decisions.why: Round 4's item answered: FR-010 and D9 now word a knob in use as scope.py measures it. Reproduced on round 5's own run (audit/scope.py into a scratch copy: scope.json and claims-deferred.json identical; 3160 executed functions, 9 knobs in use - byre_form, family_form, fan_middle, footbridge_form, kosatsuba_seat, paddy_rest, weir_form, windbreak_belt, winter_crop; 274 kept / 60 mode-a / 159 deferred open rows). Each of the 9 is resolved by name inside a function the kept maps' records hold (driver.build, HamletSpec.__post_init__, retirement_houses, stage_field, channel_footbridges, resolve_seat, place_kosatsuba, resting_plots, draw_intake, _windbreak_belt, _coarse_grain_top_up), so the file-level scan admits nothing a kept map does not execute. The two newly deferred registry claims are legitimate on purpose: the hamlet rolls bamboo and settlement_form from its own hamletgen/consts.py tables (BAMBOO_FORMS, SETTLEMENT_FORMS via plan.py _roll, which only seeds knob_rng by name), those tables and their claims stay kept, and no executed function reads the registry's bamboo or settlement_form entry (no literal resolve, no KNOBS subscript; conditions.knobs, the one reader of every entry's value_space, is not in any kept record; the spec pins of the kept maps name only paddy_rest and byre_form). A fix to the registry entry changes no kept map. The remaining narrowing - a value whose unit runs but no kept map reads (row 275's FixtureForms default privy weights) - stands as ruled on round 4.

decisions.summary: With the yard step held, three perf scaling rolls refuse their web (20 hh seed 39, 40 hh seeds 4 and 25; none at the 328-start on main, none with the step at the page's value); the plan and claims-followup.md leave this 'trade' (gate vs the three rolls) for the GM to rule
decisions.why: Not GM-only. Measured on the perf logs: 20261007T160442Z-328-end refuses scaling 6, 8, 9; the start pair at main refuses none - a regression the wave introduced (XIII), and XIII's expected exit is the fix, the waiver last. The spec's Edge Case covers it and this feature has used it on exactly this kind of roll: wave 2's brook weight at 0.05 made the 10-household bookend seed 4 refuse its web, was bisected by row and held at 3.0 on a found row (tasks.md Phase 3 note, lines 66-69: restoring 3.0 alone, of the wave's values, rolls it). The record's reason ('engine work this wave does not own') is the Edge Case's own trigger, not an exit from it. A regression-free wave 9 always exists by holding rows (at worst every conflicting row at main's value). Required: bisect by row over the held state on the three rolls, hold what makes each refuse on a found row, re-take the pair back to back; only a measured irreducible conflict goes to the GM.

decisions.summary: Wave 10 starts on top of unpushed wave 9 (each wave its own commits, gate and records, landing together) while wave 9 waits on the GM
decisions.why: LEGITIMATE for the band-3 sign-off ONLY. The push is refused without the GM's own sign-off (physically impossible for the session), and the GM's goal amendment says 'don't stop working until you hit the cap or the feature is done. If you need to ask me a question then please defer it to the end of the feature' - waiting is the blocking the GM forbade, so the exception is implied by the GM's own words and FR-006 read literally would defeat that stated purpose. FR-006's purpose (each wave complete, verified, in order, its own record) is kept on these conditions: wave 9 closed in full first - every box but the push itself (impl-drift, a green gate, the wave column) and no measured regression (W9-hold-cost-to-GM resolved); if the re-taken pair is band 2 or less wave 9 is pushed and no exception is used; wave 10's bookend start taken at wave 9's closing commit so each band is its own; the sign-off question recorded for the end of the feature. Round 1's NOT LEGITIMATE stood on a failing gate the GM would be asked to waive; with the gate green and the regression removed, the GM rules on a fixed, recorded pair.
